text:
Anya K: quick async for Argentum Labs — sharing what I did / blockers / plan

Devon R: did triage of webhook errors last night. found ~3k retries; suspect upstream 429 handling.

Linus B: started a patch to increase exponential backoff and surface 429 to the router. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4567 — needs review. will try canary after review.

Maya C: renewal check: account exec asked for timeline before their 4/12 call. can we promise a mitigation plan? customer saw latency spikes during batch jobs.

Devon R: blocker: need prod request log with trace ids to reproduce rate patterns. Anya — can you paste a small sample?

Anya K: pasted sample:
```
[2026-03-16T23:42:11Z] req_id=af12c user=argentum endpoint=/v1/stream status=500 retry=1 upstream=429
[2026-03-16T23:42:12Z] req_id=af12d user=argentum endpoint=/v1/stream status=200 latency_ms=143
```

Linus B: thanks. looks like bursts align with their nightly batch. plan: canary change to backoff + route large-batch requests to lower-capacity model (mistral-7b-lite) for 24h.

Maya C: that routing plan sounds ok — need a 1-paragraph explanation for AE. suggested blurb:
"We're rolling a temporary routing policy to reduce latency spikes during Argentum's nightly batches. This will route high-concurrency jobs to a lower-latency model and introduce aggressive retry backoff. We expect measurable reduction in 90th percentile latency within 2 hours of canary."

Sophie L: nit: change "lower-latency model" -> "cost-optimized model" maybe. :eyes:

Linus B: @Sophie L good call. updated blurb in the PR description.

Devon R: can we run a live debug in their staging window tonight ~9pm PST? need permission to enable verbose logs for 30m.

Anya K: ok from CS side. I'll notify Argentum and confirm their ops window. pls add toggle so we can turn off quickly.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy to canary-23 at 2026-03-16T21:00Z by Linus B — link: https://deploy.redwood/canary-23

Sophie L: reviewing PR now, aim to merge if CI passes. will ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

Maya C: I'll prep the AE email once PR merged. thanks team.

Anya K: thanks all. no other blockers from CS. will update once Argentum confirms 9pm.
